annotations.title: Thai immigration office hours and address

description: Use this when someone asks about a Thai immigration office: address, opening hours, whether it is open on Saturday, phone, which floor or counter, queue booking, what to bring for an extension, 90-day report, TM30 or re-entry permit. Covers Bangkok (Chaeng Watthana, Government Complex Building B), Jomtien (Pattaya, Chonburi), Chiang Mai, Phuket and Hua Hin (Prachuap Khiri Khan), and explains how to find the office for any other province. Examples: "Bangkok immigration office opening hours", "is Jomtien immigration open today", "Chiang Mai immigration address", "Phuket immigration queue", "where do I do my 90-day report in Hua Hin". Returns the office fields and registered facts with sources. Do not use for embassies or consulates abroad or for visa rules (thai_visa_details).

place.description: Town, district or province, e.g. "Bangkok", "Pattaya", "Chiang Mai", "Phuket", "Hua Hin", "Chaeng Watthana".
